title: The first collaborative motion video Agent
body:
Share files or motion videos with one link, collect feedback from colleagues and clients, and validate PMF faster.
Keep cloud and local versions in sync, reduce miscommunication, and help your team move forward efficiently.
Sync feedback back to the project for Agent to act on, keep the original link updated, and shorten delivery time.
